title: The WebFetch hook denies only rows whose routes table marks WebFetch as denied, not every avoid cell that names it
goal: The routes table of kb/_self/web-sources.md says per row whether WebFetch is denied on that host (an explicit column or marker), and ql_learn.avoided_route and the PreToolUse hook read that, so a row that only avoids a WebFetch summary as the quote (www.anthropic.com) or WebFetch of the HTML page (code.claude.com, where a .md url is fine) no longer denies a WebFetch used to locate a passage; the query log's route findings keep their count. Found by the SP-evkj4avq review in _tools/ql_learn.py avoided_route after ST-5zpbfax2.
